{{Quote|I know he sounds thuggish, but he's actually very bright, and a far better pilot than I.|Drach Coven|<ref name="CNI" />}}
'''Mok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who served as co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Far Ranger]]'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] with [[Drach Coven]]. The two were approached by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to capture the [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] [[Nick Rostu]], and the pair agreed to abduct him. Immediately after turning in Rostu and receiving the promised reward from the Empire's representative, [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], Mok and Coven were arrested for smuggling illicit materials, and their reward was taken back. They were then executed by the Empire.

==Biography==
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] Mok worked with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Drach Coven]] as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], serving as Drach's co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Far Ranger]]''. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Mok and Coven were hired by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to capture the [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] [[Nick Rostu]], who had had dealings with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]], and was considered a fugitive from justice. Mok and Coven encountered him in a salon in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]], and catching him by surprise, they [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] him. They then took Rostu aboard the ''Far Ranger'' and headed for the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], where they would meet with Imperial representatives and collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Rostu's head.<ref name="CNI" />

On the flight to the palace, Rostu earned Mok's ire by vomiting on the Weequay's boots, which Mok valued very highly. However, Coven was able to restrain him, and they landed near the palace shortly after. There, they turned Rostu over to the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], who handed over the bounty to the duo. However, Rhinann then placed them under arrest for smuggling and crimes against the [[Mercantile Guild]], and took back their reward. Coven attempted to protest, claiming that the two were authorized members of the [[Interstellar Trading League]], but the Elomin ignored him. In a rage, Mok struck one of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], only to be stunned by several others. The two were taken away, and their ship was confiscated. Shortly after this, they were killed by the Empire, while the ''Far Ranger'' was given to Rostu to help him locate Pavan, as the Korun had been tasked by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to find the Jedi.<ref name="CNI" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Mok can be a bit short-tempered&hellip;|Drach Coven|<ref name="CNI" />}}
Mok was described by Coven as being very quick to anger. He was greatly maddened when Rostu threw up on his boots, as he valued them quite highly. However, Coven was able to placate him. Mok later became enraged when placed under arrest, and attacked a stormtrooper, although he was quickly stunned. Coven considered Mok very bright, as well as an excellent pilot.<ref name="CNI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mok appeared in the [[2008]] novel ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'' by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="CNI" />
